nrow(expr_matrix)                                             # genes after filtering

```{r}
# Run WGCNA
sp <- 12
temp_cor <- cor
cor <- WGCNA::cor
net <- blockwiseModules(
  wgcna_data,
  power = sp,
  networkType = "signed",
  deepSplit = 2,
  pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
  minModuleSize = 30,
  maxBlockSize = 10000,
  reassignThreshold = 0,
  mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
  saveTOMs = TRUE,
  numericLabels = FALSE,
  verbose = 3
)
cor <- temp_cor
module_colors <- net$colors

# # Load genes of interest
data_type <- "asper"
genes_of_interest <- readr::read_delim("Asper_genes.txt",
                                         delim = "\t") %>%
                      pull("Gene ID")

# Load TOM and assign gene names
load(net$TOMFiles[1])
TOM <- as.matrix(TOM)
# only want gene names that wgcna didn't filter out
network_genes <- colnames(wgcna_data)[net$goodGenes]

rownames(TOM) <- network_genes
colnames(TOM) <- network_genes
saveRDS(TOM, "asper_TOM_p3.rds")

# get module assignments
mods <- module_colors[net$goodGenes]
gene_modules <- data.frame(Gene = network_genes, Module = mods)
write.table(gene_modules, "asper_gene_modules_p3.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
grey <- mods %in% c("grey")
# create a binary criteria for module membership
module_net <- outer(mods, mods, "==") * 1
module_net[grey, ] <- 0 # grey doesnt count as a module
module_net[, grey] <- 0
diag(module_net) <- 1 # grey genes that match with themself should be 1
rownames(module_net) <- network_genes
colnames(module_net) <- network_genes
saveRDS(module_net, "asper_TOM_modules_p3.rds")

get_top50 <- function(genes_of_interest, TOM, data_type, module_colors) {
  results <- data.frame()
  for (gene in genes_of_interest) {
    # genes that were filter out prior to wcgna
        if (!gene %in% names(module_colors)) {
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(dataset = data_type, gene = gene, correlated_gene = NA,
                                            TOM_similarity = NA,
                                            module = "not in network", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      next
    }
    gene_module <- module_colors[gene]
    # genes that were filtered out by wgcna
    if (gene_module == "grey") {
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(dataset = data_type, gene = gene, correlated_gene = NA,
                                            TOM_similarity = NA,
                                            module = "grey", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      next
    }
    # get genes in the same TOM as GOI
    same_module_genes <- names(module_colors[module_colors == gene_module])
    same_module_genes <- same_module_genes[same_module_genes != gene]
    # get the top genes by TOM for GOI

    gene_similarities <- TOM[gene, same_module_genes]
    gene_similarities <- sort(gene_similarities, decreasing = TRUE)
    top50 <- head(gene_similarities, 50)

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      dataset = data_type,
      gene = gene,
      correlated_gene = names(top50),
      TOM_similarity = as.numeric(top50),
      module = gene_module,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

results_table <- get_top50(genes_of_interest, TOM, data_type, module_colors)
write.table(results_table, paste0("asper_wgcna_top50_modules_p3.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

get_50 <- function(genes_of_interest, TOM, data_type) {
  results <- data.frame()
  for (gene in genes_of_interest) {
    # genes not in the network
    if (!gene %in% rownames(TOM)) {
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(dataset = data_type, gene = gene,
                                           correlated_gene = NA, TOM_similarity = NA,
                                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
      next
    }
    # rank every other gene by TOM to the GOI
    other_genes <- setdiff(rownames(TOM), gene)
    gene_similarities <- sort(TOM[gene, other_genes], decreasing = TRUE)
    top50 <- head(gene_similarities, 50)

    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      dataset = data_type,
      gene = gene,
      correlated_gene = names(top50),
      TOM_similarity = as.numeric(top50),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  rownames(results) <- NULL
  return(results)
}
results_table <- get_50(genes_of_interest, TOM, data_type)
write.table(results_table, paste0("asper_wgcna_top50_p3.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

pearsons  <- readRDS("asper_pearson_p3.rds")
#spearmans <- readRDS("asper_spearmans_p2.rds")

results_pearson <- get_50(genes_of_interest, pearsons, data_type)
write.table(results_pearson, "asper_pearson_top50_p3.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```
